basic_info.description: Mid-Century income producing building next to an urban open space and adjacent to the Alamo Square neighborhood. This fully detached 5-unit building is a mixture of three 1-bed units and two 2-bed units which are situated on two levels above garages and common space. Each residence has an open/living dining floorplan and are conveniently accessed by common balconies. The ground level features a low maintenance yard, access to individual storage areas and the common laundry facility. Each unit has an independent parking space with individual garage doors. Two units will be delivered vacant at the close of escrow. This vibrant location is close to the bustling Divisadero corridor and two blocks to the Painted Ladies and Alamo Square Park. Easy access to downtown, public transportation and tech shuttles. Owned by the same family for generations, this investment property presents an exceptional opportunity to purchase a first investment or add to a flourishing portfolio. Exceptional Value, Exceptional Price, Exceptional Property!!
